summary.text: Vikki Breese Iverson is a Republican state representative from Oregon House District 59 who is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026, and who works as a realtor and principal broker.

paragraphs.text: Vikki Breese-Iverson was born in Prineville, Oregon, and attended Central Oregon Community College and Oregon State University before obtaining an undergraduate degree.
Her professional experience includes working as a realtor and principal broker, and she is affiliated with the Oregon Farm Bureau and the Oregon Firearms Federation.
In a 2020 Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a fifth-generation farmer and rancher from Prineville who, with her husband, owns and operates several businesses there.

Breese-Iverson's Ballotpedia profile lists her tenure in the Oregon House of Representatives as running from 2019 to the present, and she has served as vice chair of the House Rules Committee and a member of the Joint Ways and Means Committee in the 2023-2024 session.
In that 2020 survey she listed rural Oregon issues, wildfire and forest management legislation, and Second Amendment and private property rights among her priorities.
She advanced from the Republican primary on May 19, 2026, and faces Democrat Lawrence Jones in the general election.
